questions.question: What is the fundamental economic problem?
What is opportunity cost?
options: The value of the next best alternative foregone

questions.question: What is the law of demand?
options: As price increases, quantity demanded decreases
As price increases, quantity demanded increases

questions.question: What is the law of supply?
options: As price increases, quantity supplied increases
As price increases, quantity supplied decreases

questions.question: What is elasticity of demand?
options: How responsive quantity demanded is to price changes

questions.question: What is a normal good?
options: A good whose demand increases when income increases
A good that is always available

questions.question: What is an inferior good?
options: A good whose demand decreases when income increases

questions.question: What is a substitute good?
options: A good that can replace another good
A good that is better quality

questions.question: What is a complementary good?
options: A good that is used together with another good
A good that is better quality

questions.question: What is consumer surplus?
options: The difference between what consumers are willing to pay and what they actually pay

questions.question: What is producer surplus?
options: The difference between what producers receive and what they are willing to accept

questions.question: What is a price ceiling?
options: A maximum price set by government
A minimum price set by government
The highest price in the market
The lowest price in the market

questions.question: What is a price floor?
options: A minimum price set by government
A maximum price set by government
The lowest price in the market
The highest price in the market

questions.question: What is the invisible hand?
options: The market mechanism that guides self-interested individuals to promote social welfare
